lines.t:
The standby state of an <c:ffff00>{{interrupt_guard}}<c>.
In {{guard}} Stance, no other <c:ffff00>act<c> can be performed and
the Medabot becomes <c:ffff00>unable to evade<c>.
The stance ends and <c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c> begins if allies act 4
times or a set time passes.
Depending on the <c:ffff00>action<c>, the <c:ffff00>attacks<c> that trigger
the {{interrupt_guard}} differ. The <c:ffff00>{{acting_part}}<c> of the
stance is the one that <c:ffff00>defends<c>.
